marta: Quick check — RCA items from INC-912. We still have 3 open actions: log-ttl config, model-fallback playbook, test-suite backfill. Can owners pls ack and give firm due dates? Prefer EOW Tue for anything small.

devon: I can own the log-ttl config change. Will open a PR today and target Wed EOD for deployment.

alyssa: I will take the model-fallback playbook. Need a 30m sync with oncall to confirm rollback thresholds. Ping @samir.

samir: ack — I can do the sync tomorrow 10:30. For thresholds, use current SLOs (latency p95 200ms) and we should failover after 3 consecutive errors.

pm_jordan: test-suite backfill — putting this on my team's backlog. Tentative target 2025-04-01, depends on infra free slots. I'll create the ticket and assign to QA.

incident-bot: INC-912 RCA: assigned log-ttl -> devon, model-fallback -> alyssa, test-backfill -> pm_jordan.

marta: thanks. Please update the tracker spreadsheet when you create PRs/tickets: https://docs.internal/inc-912-rca (add PR/ticket links + short acceptance criteria).

devon: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/log-ttl-fix/pull/42 — small config tweak, includes canary plan. Will link to spreadsheet after CI passes.

alyssa: first draft of playbook uploaded: https://docs.internal/playbooks/model-fallback. I'll iterate after sync with @samir and aim to finalize by Tue EOD.

pm_jordan: created ticket TICKET-784, assigned to QA lead @nina, ETA 2025-04-01 (marked tentative). Link in tracker.

marta: great — to confirm: devon ETA Wed EOD, alyssa EOD Tue, pm_jordan target 2025-04-01 (tentative). If anything slips, ping this thread and update the sheet. :thumbsup:
